requirements.title: API-driven landing config and scope-safe failure
requirements.description: Public root and eligible app routes render ordered typed presentation and commerce-owner facts with optional variant_slug. Resolution failure uses only explicitly configured validated same-product fallback, or returns unavailable when none exists; locale fallback reports its actual locale and reason. Generic baked product narratives cannot substitute for the requested scope.

validation.notes: Proves absent publication cannot substitute generic content on an app detail route. The amended OT-P0-031 follows the accepted product-scope contract. No last-known-good fallback store or fallback activation is claimed.
Proves root fails unavailable when no public revision exists instead of emitting baked marketing copy.
Red-to-green regression proves top-level and nested fallback flags agree, resolved locale and reason are explicit, and root/detail keep their app, variant and route identities.
Observer BAS smoke case verifies the public runtime landing surface renders after configuration resolution.

requirements.title: Split customization layout
requirements.description: Typed presentation editing and private preview use two columns on desktop and stack on mobile.

validation.notes: Mounted editor regression proves the editing and preview regions share the split-layout container, preserve source, and use the same private renderer. Browser layout measurements at 320/390/768/1440 are retained in the UI presentation README; these are isolated editor fixtures, not live authenticated-backend proof.

requirements.title: Live preview updates
requirements.description: Valid local document edits request a read-only private preview after a 300ms debounce without saving, publishing, or reloading the page.

validation.notes: Six mounted regressions cover debounce, no automatic writes, stale route/locale responses, invalid edits, retained-revision inspection, and authorization loss. Parent independently passed the focused UI suite.
Generated Preview document path validates and resolves without changing stored revisions or generation. Known-variant and missing/expired lease checks have separate backend regressions.
